controls.name: Authority Registry
controls.responsibility: Resolve verified human identity and source authority from scoped, time-limited, revocable records.

controls.name: Execution and Permission Policies
controls.responsibility: Constrain each operator to explicitly granted actions within one workspace.

controls.name: Governance Rules and Decision Controls
controls.responsibility: Evaluate each proposed task against versioned policy; fail closed when requirements are missing.

controls.name: Evidence Validation and Audit Mechanisms
controls.responsibility: Validate evidence references, integrity, freshness, and record decision events for audit.

controls.name: Human Approval and Authorization Framework
controls.responsibility: Require distinct, verified human approval for consequential decisions; AI operators cannot approve their own proposals.

controls.name: Risk Controls and Enforcement Logic
controls.responsibility: Block prohibited actions and enforce escalation, separation of duties, and fail-closed behavior.

runtimeBoundary.note: These identifiers map the six agreed Governance Core control domains. This file does not claim the in-memory Governance Core has become a production service.
